title: 第十章 砸场！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

议论传出，叶凡没理会，继续选。

等再选五块，原石达到二十块，他才停下。

“一共多少钱？”

女销售拿计算器算了下，恭敬道，“先生，这二十块原石，加在一起是一百一十六万…”

“结账！”

叶凡干脆道，女销售一脸兴奋，带叶凡到了结算处。

等钱到账后，女销售恭敬道，“先生，这些原石您是想现场解开，还是运到您指定的地方？”

“当然现场解。”叶凡冷冷一笑，“把你们梦金园的解石师傅叫来吧。”

“好！”

女销售应声，拨通电话。

没多久，一个身穿唐装，鬓角微白的老者走来。

“呵呵，先生你好，我叫杨京，是梦金园的二级鉴定师，也是解石师。”

“杨京？”叶凡眼睛一眯，“你姓杨，这么看你是杨家的人？杨旭和你什么关系？”

“哦？先生认识我侄儿？我是他大伯。”杨京一愣。

“嘿嘿，原来是大伯啊。”叶凡冷笑，“没错，我的确认识杨旭，我和他交情很深，说是生死之交都不为过。”

“生死之交？”

杨京一挑眉，明显没听明白，叶凡没解释，冷笑道，“行了杨师傅，你解石吧，我想看看我运气如何。”

“嗯，好吧。”

杨京虽心中疑惑，但知道叶凡是付钱的客人，一招手。

很快一台玉石切料机推过来，四周客人向这聚集。

杨京开始动作，十几秒后，第一块原石被解开。

七八块拳头大小的白色翡翠出现，四周人一愣。

“这小子运气不错啊，第一块腊肉原石就开出糯种飘花，这一下价值就翻了三倍！”

“哼，这才哪到哪，看后面。”

议论响起，叶凡没理，杨京一脸平静，开始切第二块。

等第二块切开，围观众人又一愣，第二块黄盐沙原石，也开出糯冰，这又赚三倍！

然后是第三块，第四块，一直到第二十块！

叶凡买的每块原石，都开出超出原石本身价值三倍的翡翠！

特别是最后一块顶级脱沙皮原石，其中竟开出一块完整冰种！

这价格瞬间翻十倍！

众人沉默。

本来他们觉得叶凡是傻富二代，有钱骚包。

现在他们才明白，傻的是他们！

“这…不知先生高姓大名？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When the discussion spread, Ye Fan ignored it and continued to choose.

He didn't stop until he selected five more pieces and the rough stone reached twenty pieces.

"How much is the total?"

The saleswoman took a calculator and calculated it, and said respectfully, "Sir, the total of these twenty rough stones is 1.16 million..."

"Check out!"

Ye Fan said simply, the female salesperson looked excited and took Ye Fan to the settlement office.

After the money arrived, the saleswoman said respectfully, "Sir, do you want to unlock these rough stones on site, or transport them to a place you designate?"

"Of course it will be solved on the spot." Ye Fan smiled coldly, "Call your stone-solving master from Mengjinyuan."

"Okay!"

The saleswoman answered and dialed the phone.

Not long after, an old man wearing a Tang suit with slightly white temples came over.

"Haha, hello sir, my name is Yang Jing, I am the second-level appraiser of Mengjinyuan and also a stone analyzer."

"Yang Jing?" Ye Fan narrowed his eyes, "Your surname is Yang, so you are from the Yang family? What is the relationship between Yang Xu and you?"

"Oh? Sir, do you know my nephew? I am his uncle." Yang Jing was stunned.

"Hehe, it turns out it's the uncle." Ye Fan sneered, "Yes, I do know Yang Xu. I have a deep friendship with him. It is not an exaggeration to say that we are life and death friends."

"Friends of life and death?"

Yang Jing raised his eyebrows, obviously not understanding. Ye Fan did not explain, but sneered, "Okay, Master Yang, you can solve the stone. I want to see how lucky I am."

"Yeah, okay."

Although Yang Jing was confused, he knew that Ye Fan was a paying customer and waved.

Soon a jade cutting machine rolled over, and customers gathered around it.

Yang Jing started to move, and after more than ten seconds, the first rough stone was unlocked.

Seven or eight fist-sized pieces of white jade appeared, and everyone around was stunned.

"This kid is very lucky. The first piece of raw bacon stone bloomed with waxy flowers, and the value tripled!"

"Hmph, where are we going? Look at the back."

There was a discussion, but Ye Fan ignored it. Yang Jing looked calm and started to cut the second piece.

When the second piece was cut open, the onlookers were stunned again. The second piece of yellow salt sand rough stone also revealed waxy ice. This made the profit three times more!

Then the third piece, the fourth piece, all the way to the twentieth piece!

Every rough stone that Ye Fan bought was found to be jade that was three times more than the value of the rough stone itself!

Especially the last piece of top-grade sand-skin rough stone, which actually contains a complete ice species!

The price instantly doubled tenfold!

Everyone was silent.

Originally, they thought Ye Fan was a stupid rich second generation, rich showman.

Now they realize that they are the ones who are stupid!

"This...I don't know what your surname is, sir?"
